description: Direct test of the bug found on the first real call: the agent inserted an extra digit reading a number back. Digits must match exactly.

caller.persona: Miguel Castillo, calling about a clogged bathroom drain. Says his number one digit at a time when asked.

facts.name: Miguel Castillo
facts.phone number: 6 7 8 3 3 1 9 9 2 3 — say it exactly like that, digit by digit

caller.goal: get someone out for the clogged drain. When asked for your number, give it digit by digit exactly as written above. Confirm it if it is read back correctly.
